Pokémon Campaign

Private Player Messages

Tap any route, city, gym, or landmark on the Kanto map to open its campaign details.

Settings

Campaign Account

Sign out of the current campaign account to switch between the DM and player views.

Cloud Campaign Migration

DM only. Upload the campaign currently stored on this device to the shared Supabase campaign. This replaces the cloud trainer and Pokémon records, while keeping your local campaign intact.

App Updates

Checks the currently deployed GitHub Pages app, clears app caches, and reloads the newest copy without needing a version-file change.

Map Image Preload

Map and badge images preload automatically after the app opens. Use this button to manually reload them into the browser image cache if needed.

Backup & Restore

Backup Files

Export your complete campaign as a JSON file, including Pokémon, trainers, inventories, money, completed trainers, encounter/reward state, PC level, Kanto route/town visited/completed progress, gym badge progress, campaign notes, and other persistent campaign data added by future app features. On iPhone or iPad, use Share / Save to Files if you want to place the backup directly in the Files app.

Restore Backup File

Select a JSON backup file from Files. Restoring replaces the campaign currently stored on this device after first creating a safety snapshot.

Manual Backups

Manual snapshots include the same persistent campaign data as exported backups, including notes, Kanto map progress, gym badges, and completed route encounters. The app keeps only the newest 12 manual snapshots.

Automatic Backups

Automatic snapshots include persistent campaign data, notes, and Kanto map progress whenever the app creates a new snapshot. The app keeps only the newest 12 automatic snapshots. Older automatic snapshots are removed automatically.

Reset Campaign

Permanently erase all saved campaign data on this device and return the app to a brand-new campaign: Pokémon, trainers, completed trainers, inventories, money, battle/encounter state, visited/completed map locations, gym badges, local backup snapshots, and campaign level.

Export a backup first if you may want this campaign again.
